description:
Validates an end-to-end eligible flight disruption claim scenario for a multi-passenger booking (3 passengers) where the primary claimant is a Basic Aeroplan member. Flight AC 301 is delayed 4 hours on a single domestic leg due to a controllable reason (Code 68 � Flight Crew Shortage / Crew Rest). APPR regime applies under Tier 1 delay compensation ($400 CAD per passenger, totaling $1,200 CAD Cash or $1,440 CAD AC Wallet with 20% top-up). The customer selects Cash (Interac e-Transfer) over AC Wallet. Confirms that DDS evaluates APPR eligibility correctly (generating EL-01 response), CyberSource passes GREEN, Persona IDV passes, the bot collects only the email ID for Interac e-Transfer (Canada resident), and the Claims Dashboard reflects all 3 passengers with read-only resolution.

PNR: TC003 � 3 passengers: Catherine Bouchard (Adult - Claimant, Basic Aeroplan Member 9876543210), Alexandre Bouchard (Adult), Sophie Bouchard (Child). Journey: 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 18:00 (4hr delay). Arrival delay code: 68 (Flight Crew Shortage / Crew Rest � Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+13). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. Persona: Configured to return IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD).
